facts.quote: Under the rules, the organisation that survives the merger cannot change its objectives for five years from the end of the financial year in which the merger takes place.
facts.text: The entity surviving a charitable trust merger is barred from changing its objectives for 5 years from the end of the financial year of the merger.

card.line: Trust jude to I-T ko batao

scenes.vo: Ek: Trust jude to I-T ko batana padega, purana tax bhi naya trust bharega.
Do: Binance crypto exchange mein record hack, zyaadatar chori hua paisa company ne bhara.
Teen: Aaj se GST registration aasaan, chhote online sellers ko refund bhi jaldi milega.
Chaar: Sarkari bijli company NTPC ka munafa badha, green wing ka aur tezi se.
Paanch: Jio Platforms listing ke baad chadha, baaki Reliance shares ka haal mila-jula.
Chhe: Cotton import par duty chhoot saal-end tak badhi, textile ko raahat.
Saat: NTPC ka akela munafa bhi badha, aur kamaai bhi.
Aath: Kuch shares lagaatar kai din chadhe, par yeh khareedne ki salah nahi.
Nau: Karnataka mein ganna kisan daam ke liye dharne par, prashasan ne rok lagayi.
Das: Fund manager Naren: silver ke peeche sab bhaage, phir gira. Yeh investment advice nahi hai.
Yeh us dost ko bhejo jo roz paise ki khabar miss kar deta hai.
